name: deepseek-bridge
description: Claude stays the orchestrator; DeepSeek (via opencode) implements, with the full conversation as context, long-running agentic runs, a goal loop verified by your own check command, and recovery when its output is lost.

opencodeMcp.title: opencode MCP servers + plugins
opencodeMcp.description: off: the implementer runs without your opencode MCP servers/plugins (about 14x fewer input tokens per call). on: leave them as configured.

delegate.title: Tell Claude to delegate
delegate.description: on: add a short system-prompt section telling the main model to delegate well-scoped implementation work to the implement tool.

timeoutMinutes.title: Max minutes per call
timeoutMinutes.description: Hard time limit for one implement call. The work stays in the tree and the next call continues the session.

idleMinutes.title: Stall limit (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Stop a run that has produced no output for this long.

scrubEnv.title: Hide secrets from the implementer
scrubEnv.description: on: before opencode starts, drop environment variables that look like secrets (names containing KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASS, CREDENTIAL, COOKIE, AUTH, DSN, PRIVATE; AWS_*; any URL with a password). Best effort against an agent that dumps its environment; it is not a sandbox.

webSearch.title: Web search for the implementer
webSearch.description: on: enable opencode's built-in web search (its queries go to Exa, a third party). off: the implementer can still fetch URLs it is given.
